description: This file defines an interface for building responses and events related to modifying feature definitions in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It specifies factory methods for creating command responses and event instances triggered by modify feature definition commands.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building responses and events for ModifyFeatureDefinition live commands, extending a generic response builder with specific response and event factories.

methods.name: ResponseFactory
methods.description: A nested interface defining factory methods to create command responses such as created, modified, or error responses for feature definitions.

methods.name: EventFactory
methods.description: A nested interface defining factory methods to create event instances like created and modified feature definition events.
